images.subject: A fusion power plant built around one colossal upright ring-shaped tokamak containment torus. In the bottom right corner of the frame, in front of the cliff, stands a second large and clearly separate block: two giant hyperboloid cooling towers, each as tall as the ring, releasing thick white plumes of steam into the sky. In the bottom of the frame, in the foreground and larger than the ring, a third massive and clearly separate block: a huge plasma injector building, star-shaped, from which several brilliant blue-white beams of energy shoot toward the ring.
images.detail: Blue-white plasma glows brightly through wide windows along the ring.
